test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are sitting in a straight row facing north. Only two people sit to the right of S. Only three people sit between Q and S. R sits to the immediate right of S and to the immediate left of U. T sits to the immediate right of P. P is not a neighbour of Q.

Who sits second from the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are sitting in a straight row facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the right of S.

2) Only three people sit between Q and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10acb7302a9d9c47aa9f7df7f9731d47d8558edc5f50ebccb4a3d451e419af7a.png] 

3) R sits to the immediate right of S and to the immediate left of U.
